dictionary.tab.title: Cameras
dictionary.privacy.title: Privacy — read before recording
dictionary.privacy.body: Recording is off by default. Turn it on only with the consent of anyone who may be filmed, and people present must be able to tell that the camera is recording (indicator on). Videos stay on the device for the chosen loop length and are then deleted. Motion detection only compares the difference between two small images and keeps nothing.
dictionary.privacy.analysis: Automatic video analysis (lip reading, speaker recognition) is not active.
